question: What were Toro's trailing-twelve-month Professional segment net sales and segment profit (EBIT) as of the end of its fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended July 31, 2026), and what was the implied TTM segment margin?
grading: Computation: TTM = FY2025 + nine months FY2026 - nine months FY2025. TTM Professional net sales USD 3,853.5M and segment profit USD 748.5M (each +/-0.5%); margin 19.42% (+/-0.3pp; accept 19.4%). Fail if the dollar figures are nine-month, fiscal-2025 or quarterly values, or a different segment is used.
answer: TTM Professional net sales = 3,624.0 (FY2025) + 2,943.2 (nine months FY2026) - 2,713.7 (nine months FY2025) = USD 3,853.5 million. TTM Professional segment profit (EBIT) = 702.5 + 573.8 - 527.8 = USD 748.5 million. TTM segment margin = 748.5 / 3,853.5 = 19.42% [H12-E1][H12-E2].

output.answer:
## Toro (TTC) — Professional Segment TTM (as of fiscal Q3 2026, ended July 31, 2026)

TTM figures are built as: **FY2025 (ended Oct 31, 2025) − 9M FY2025 + 9M FY2026**.

| Component | Professional Net Sales | Professional Segment Profit (EBIT) |
|---|---|---|
| FY2025 full year (ended 10/31/25) | $3,624.0M | $702.5M |
| Less: 9M FY2025 (ended 8/1/25) | −$2,713.7M | −$527.8M |
| = Q4 FY2025 | $910.3M | $174.7M |
| Plus: 9M FY2026 (ended 7/31/26) | +$2,943.2M | +$573.8M |
| **TTM (ended 7/31/26)** | **$3,853.5M** | **$748.5M** |

### Implied TTM segment margin
**$748.5M ÷ $3,853.5M ≈ 19.4%**

### Context
- Q3 FY2026 Professional net sales were $1,012.6M, up 8.8% YoY (6.1% organic; acquisition contribution from the Tornado Infrastructure business).
- Q3 FY2026 Professional segment profit was $211.8M, a 20.9% margin, down ~40 bps YoY on product mix and higher manufacturing costs, partly offset by pricing, productivity and volume leverage.
- The TTM margin (~19.4%) is essentially flat versus FY2025's full-year Professional EBIT margin of 19.4% ($702.5M / $3,624.0M).

**Caveats:** Segment profit here is Toro's reported GAAP segment profit (EBIT); it is not adjusted for the $43M non-cash impairment in Q3 FY2026 (booked outside segment profit / in "Other"). TTM is a calculated roll-forward, not a figure Toro itself reports. Note also that Toro conformed the prior-year Q3 segment profit presentation to the current-year basis.

**Sources:**
- Toro Q3 FY2026 results (Nasdaq/Business Wire): https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/toro-company-reports-record-third-quarter-results-2026-09-03
- Toro Q4/FY2025 results: https://www.thetorocompany.com/news-releases/news-release-details/toro-company-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-fiscal-2025
- Toro FY2025 Form 10-K (segment EBIT/margin): https://www.thetorocompany.com/static-files/8d6d91d0-43f6-4f0b-b306-59d274e3aa3c
- Toro Q3 FY2025 results (9M FY2025 comparatives): https://www.thetorocompany.com/news-releases/news-release-details/toro-company-reports-fiscal-2025-third-quarter-results
